payload.title: Preserve literal Git paths in integration population authentication
payload.summary: P2 conservative false refusal in maintained Integration._files. A real canonical tiny repository and Checkout contain the exact planned staged tests/test_π.py bytes. Git diff --name-only quotes the path as tests/test_\317\200.py; the validator compares that rendered string against the literal plan population and raises Unapproved files in integration checkout. NUL-delimited output independently returns the exact literal path. Canonical RepositoryResourceAddress accepts the path; no foreign file or production grant was involved. This proves exact-population refusal, not a protected-publication bypass. Similar line-based joins in local committed replay and closeout require bounded inspection, not assumed automatic credit.
payload.benefit: Acceptance: exact real-Git/Checkout populations for ASCII, Unicode, spaces and supported quoted characters authenticate planned bytes and still refuse foreign additions. Use Git -z/trim=False with existing managed Git semantics and explicit literal path comparisons; inspect all affected changed/untracked sets and committed replay consumers. Do not solve by disabling core.quotepath globally or weakening subset checks. Retain scope, source identity, history and authority; full focused/static/protected100% validation in the future bounded repair.
payload.uncertainty: Independent bounded synthetic evidence; no claim of actual retained production corruption, autonomous effectiveness or permission bypass. Audit only: correction needs separate bounded implementation authorization.
